summary.text: Joey Garcia is a Democratic member of the West Virginia Senate from District 13, listed with Marion County; the district covers parts of Marion and Monongalia counties. His legislative page lists him as Assistant Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Garcia's page gives his birth date as January 30, 1983, and his birthplace as Marietta, Ohio.

It lists a J.D. from the West Virginia University College of Law (2009), a B.A. in history from West Virginia University (2005), and Fairmont Senior High School (2001), and gives his occupation as attorney.

It names his spouse as Heather Hoelscher and lists his affiliations as the Marion County Chamber of Commerce, the Fairmont Marion County Regional Airport Authority, the West Virginia Association for Justice and the Fairmont Lions Club.

Garcia's Senate committee assignments include Banking and Insurance, Education, Energy, Industry and Mining, Health and Human Resources, Interstate Cooperation, Judiciary, Natural Resources and Transportation and Infrastructure.
